      summary: Fetch All records
      description: |-
        This API retrieves multiple records in a single request with support for filtering by kind, deleted status and lastModifiedDate. It is paginated, using a cursor parameter to fetch subsequent pages.The default page size is 20, configurable via the limit parameter.
        Allowed roles: `service.storage.viewer`,`service.storage.creator` and `service.storage.admin`.
      operationId: getAllRecords
      parameters:
      - name: x-collaboration
        in: header
        description: x-collaboration
        required: false
        schema:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          pattern: "^id=[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-([0-9a-fA-F]{4}-){3}[0-9a-fA-F]{12},application=[a-zA-Z0-9\
            \ ]{1,128}$"
      - name: limit
        in: query
        description: Page Size
        required: false
        schema:
          type: integer
          format: int32
          default: 20
          maximum: 100
          minimum: 1
        example: 20
      - name: kind
        in: query
        description: Filter Kind
        required: false
        schema:
          type: string
          pattern: "^[\\w\\-\\.]+:[\\w\\-\\.]+:[\\w\\-\\.]+:[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+$"

        required: false
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: deleted
        in: query

        required: false
        schema:
          type: boolean
          default: false
        example: true
      - name: modifiedAfterDate
        in: query
        description: Get records modified after this date
        required: false
        schema:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        example: 2025-09-04
      - name: sortOrder
        in: query
        description: Sort Order
        required: false
        schema:
          type: string
          default: DESC
          description: Sort direction for search results.
          enum:
          - ASC
          - DESC
      - name: data-partition-id
        in: header
        description: Tenant Id
        required: true
        schema:
          type: string
          minLength: 1

          description: Record retrieved successfully.

        "400":

        "500":

          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/AppError"
        "502":
          description: Bad Gateway
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/AppError"
        "503":
          description: Service Unavailable
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/AppError"

      - Authorization: []
    put:
      tags:
      - records
      summary: Create or Update Records
      description: "The API represents the main injection mechanism into the Data\
        \ Ecosystem. \nIt allows records creation and/or update.When no record id\
        \ is provided or when the provided id is not already present in the Data Ecosystem\
        \ then a new record is created. \n If the id is related to an existing record\

        \ of the record is created."

      description: "The API represents the patch update mechanism for records. It\
        \ allows updating multiple records in one request. The API supports metadata\
        \ update only (Legal Tags, ACLs and Tags) if the request body media type is\
        \ `application/json`. The API supports metadata and data update (Legal Tags,\
        \ ACLs, Tags, Ancestry, Kind, Meta and Data) if the request body media type\
        \ is `application/json-patch+json`. Please choose the appropriate media type\
        \ from the Request body dropdown. The currently supported operations are replace,\
        \ add, and remove. \nRequired roles: `users.datalake.editors` or `users.datalake.admins`."
      operationId: updateRecordsMetadata

            \ ]{1,128}$"
      - name: data-partition-id

        required: true
        schema:
          type: string

      requestBody:
        content:

        required: true
      responses:
        "200":

components:
  schemas:
    ByBoundingBox:
      type: object
      description: Bounding box filter defined by top-left and bottom-right coordinate
        points.
      example:
        topLeft:
          latitude: 45
          longitude: -100
        bottomRight:
          latitude: 0
          longitude: 0
      properties:
        topLeft:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/Point"
          description: Top left corner of the bounding box.
        bottomRight:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/Point"
          description: Bottom right corner of the bounding box.
      required:
      - bottomRight
      - topLeft
    ByBoundingBoxOnly:
      type: object
      description: Spatial filter using a bounding box.
      example:
        field: data.SpatialLocation.Wgs84Coordinates
        byBoundingBox:
          topLeft:
            latitude: 45
            longitude: -100
          bottomRight:
            latitude: 0
            longitude: 0
      properties:
        field:
          type: string
          description: geo-point field in the index on which filtering will be performed.
            Use GET schema API to find which fields supports spatial search.
          example: data.SpatialLocation.Wgs84Coordinates
          minLength: 1
          pattern: .*\S.*
        byBoundingBox:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/ByBoundingBox"
          description: A query allowing to filter hits based on a point location within
            a bounding box.
      required:
      - byBoundingBox
      - field
    ByDistance:
      type: object
      description: Distance filter returning results within a given radius of a coordinate
        point.
      properties:
        distance:
          type: number
          format: double
          description: The radius of the circle centered on the specified location.
            Points which fall into this circle are considered to be matches.
          example: 1500
          maximum: 9223372036854775807
          minimum: 0
        point:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/Point"
          description: Center point of the query.
      required:
      - distance
      - point
    ByDistanceOnly:
      type: object
      description: Spatial filter using distance from a point.
      properties:
        field:
          type: string
          description: geo-point field in the index on which filtering will be performed.
            Use GET schema API to find which fields supports spatial search.
          example: data.SpatialLocation.Wgs84Coordinates
          minLength: 1
          pattern: .*\S.*
        byDistance:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/ByDistance"
          description: Filters documents that include only hits that exist within
            a specific distance from a geo point.
      required:
      - byDistance
      - field
    ByGeoPolygon:
      type: object
      description: Polygon filter returning results within the given geographic polygon.
      example:
        points:
        - latitude: 26.12362
          longitude: -112.226716
        - latitude: 26.595873
          longitude: -68.457186
        - latitude: 52.273184
          longitude: -93.593904
      properties:
        points:
          type: array
          description: "Polygon defined by a set of points. Open ring: at least 3\
            \ distinct points with first != last. Closed ring: at least 4 points with\
            \ the first point repeated at the end."
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/Point"
          minItems: 3
      required:
      - points
    ByGeoPolygonOnly:
      type: object
      description: Spatial filter using a geo polygon.
      example:
        field: data.SpatialLocation.Wgs84Coordinates
        byGeoPolygon:
          points:
          - latitude: 26.12362
            longitude: -112.226716
          - latitude: 26.595873
            longitude: -68.457186
          - latitude: 52.273184
            longitude: -93.593904
      properties:
        field:
          type: string
          description: geo-point field in the index on which filtering will be performed.
            Use GET schema API to find which fields supports spatial search.
          example: data.SpatialLocation.Wgs84Coordinates
          minLength: 1
          pattern: .*\S.*
        byGeoPolygon:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/ByGeoPolygon"
          description: A query allowing to filter hits that only fall within a polygon
            of points.
      required:
      - byGeoPolygon
      - field
    ByIntersection:
      type: object
      description: Intersection filter returning results whose geometry intersects
        the given polygons.
      properties:
        polygons:
          type: array
          description: List of polygons each defined by a set of points.
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/Polygon"
      required:
      - polygons
    ByIntersectionOnly:
      type: object
      description: Spatial filter using polygon intersection.
      properties:
        field:
          type: string
          description: geo-point field in the index on which filtering will be performed.
            Use GET schema API to find which fields supports spatial search.
          example: data.SpatialLocation.Wgs84Coordinates
          minLength: 1
          pattern: .*\S.*
        byIntersection:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/ByIntersection"
          description: A query allowing to filter documents by intersecting polygons
      required:
      - byIntersection
      - field
    ByWithinPolygon:
      type: object
      description: Within-polygon filter returning results contained within the given
        polygon.
      properties:
        points:
          type: array
          description: "Polygon defined by a set of points. Open ring: at least 3\
            \ distinct points with first != last. Closed ring: at least 4 points with\
            \ the first point repeated at the end."
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/Point"
      required:
      - points
    ByWithinPolygonOnly:
      type: object
      description: Spatial filter using a within-polygon criterion.
      properties:
        field:
          type: string
          description: geo-point field in the index on which filtering will be performed.
            Use GET schema API to find which fields supports spatial search.
          example: data.SpatialLocation.Wgs84Coordinates
          minLength: 1
          pattern: .*\S.*
        byWithinPolygon:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/ByWithinPolygon"
          description: A query allowing to filter documents by checking if any points
            are within polygon on document
      required:
      - byWithinPolygon
      - field
    CursorQueryRequest:
      type: object
      description: Search query request using cursor-based pagination for retrieving
        large result sets.
      properties:
        kind:
          anyOf:
          - type: string
            description: "A single data kind, formatted {authority}:{source}:{entityType}:{version}."
            example: opendes:osdu:wellbore:1.0.0
            pattern: "^[\\w.*-]+:[\\w.*-]+:[\\w.*-]+:[\\d.*]+$"
          - type: array
            description: A list of data kinds to search.
            items:
              type: string
              description: "A single data kind, formatted {authority}:{source}:{entityType}:{version}."
              example: opendes:osdu:wellbore:1.0.0
              pattern: "^[\\w.*-]+:[\\w.*-]+:[\\w.*-]+:[\\d.*]+$"
            minItems: 1
          description: "The type(s) of data to search. Accepts a single kind string\
            \ or a list of kinds. Format: {Data-Partition-Id}:{source}:{type}:{version}.\
            \ Wildcards are supported per segment, e.g. 'opendes:*:*:*'."
        limit:
          type: integer
          format: int32
          description: "The maximum number of results to return from the given offset.\
            \ If no limit is provided, then it will return 10 items. Max number of\
            \ items which can be fetched by the query is 1000. (If you wish to fetch\
            \ large set of items, please use query_with_cursor API)"
          example: 30
          maximum: 2147483647
          minimum: 0
        query:
          type: string
          description: The query string in Lucene query string syntax.
          example: "data.country: \"US\""
        suggestPhrase:
          type: string
          description: Part of the phrase for which search should return completions
          example: wellb
        highlightedFields:
          type: array
          description: The fields where matches should be highlighted.
          example:
          - data.wellName
          items:
            type: string
        returnedFields:
          type: array
          description: The fields on which to project the results.
          example:
          - id
          - kind
          - data.wellName
          items:
            type: string
        excludedFields:
          type: array
          description: The fields on which to exclude from the results.
          example:
          - data.rawData
          items:
            type: string
        sort:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/SortQuery"
          description: The fields and orders to return sorted results.
        queryAsOwner:
          type: boolean
          description: The queryAsOwner switches between viewer and owner to return
            results that you are entitled to view or results you are the owner of.
          example: false
        trackTotalCount:
          type: boolean
          description: "Tracks accurate record count matching the query if 'true',\
            \ partial count otherwise. Partial count queries are more performant.\
            \ Default is 'false' and returns 10000 if matching records are higher\
            \ than 10000."
          example: false
        spatialFilter:
          description: A spatial filter to apply.
          oneOf:
          - $ref: "#/components/schemas/ByBoundingBoxOnly"
          - $ref: "#/components/schemas/ByDistanceOnly"
          - $ref: "#/components/schemas/ByGeoPolygonOnly"
          - $ref: "#/components/schemas/ByIntersectionOnly"
          - $ref: "#/components/schemas/ByWithinPolygonOnly"
        cursor:
          type:
          - string
          - "null"
          description: Search context to retrieve the next page of results. Null when
            there are no more results.
          example: 098F6BCD4621D373CADE4E832627B4F6
          maxLength: 32
          minLength: 32
          pattern: "^[0-9A-F]{32}$"
      required:
      - kind
    Point:
      type: object
      description: A geographic coordinate expressed as a latitude/longitude pair.
      properties:
        latitude:
          type: number
          format: double
          description: Latitude of point.
          example: 37.450727
          maximum: 90
          minimum: -90
        longitude:
          type: number
          format: double
          description: Longitude of point.
          example: -122.174762
          maximum: 180
          minimum: -180
      required:
      - latitude
      - longitude
    Polygon:
      type: object
      description: A polygon defined by an ordered list of geographic coordinate points.
      properties:
        points:
          type: array
          description: List of points making up a polygon
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/Point"
    SortQuery:
      type: object
      description: "Defines the sort criteria for search results, including field\
        \ names, sort direction, and optional filters."
      properties:
        field:
          type: array
          description: The list of fields to sort the results.
          items:
            type: string
            minLength: 1

components:
  schemas:
    Acl:
      type: object
      description: Access control lists defining which groups can view or own a record.
      properties:
        viewers:
          type: array
          description: List of valid groups which will have view/read privileges over
            the record.
          items:
            type: string
            example: data.default.viewers@opendes.contoso.com
            pattern: "^data\\.[a-zA-Z0-9_+&*-]+(?:\\.[a-zA-Z0-9_+&*-]+)*@(?:[a-zA-Z](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?\\\
              .)+[a-zA-Z](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?$"
          minItems: 1
        owners:
          type: array
          description: List of valid groups which will have write privileges over
            the record.
          items:
            type: string
            example: data.default.owners@opendes.contoso.com
            pattern: "^data\\.[a-zA-Z0-9_+&*-]+(?:\\.[a-zA-Z0-9_+&*-]+)*@(?:[a-zA-Z](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?\\\
              .)+[a-zA-Z](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?$"
          minItems: 1
      required:
      - owners
      - viewers
    CreateDatasetRegistryRequest:
      type: object
      description: Dataset registry ids
      properties:
        datasetRegistries:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/Record"
          maxItems: 20
          minItems: 1
      required:
      - datasetRegistries
    Legal:
      type: object
      properties:
        legaltags:
          type: array
          description: List of legal tag names associated with this record.
          items:
            type: string
            example: opendes-Default-Legal-Tag
          minItems: 1
          uniqueItems: true
        otherRelevantDataCountries:
          type: array
          description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes of other relevant data countries.
          items:
            type: string
            example: US
          minItems: 1
          uniqueItems: true
        status:
          type: string
          description: "Compliance status of the legal tags, assigned by the server."
          enum:
          - compliant
          - incompliant
          example: compliant
          readOnly: true
      required:
      - legaltags
      - otherRelevantDataCountries
    Record:
      type: object
      description: "An OSDU record containing a data payload, access control, legal\
        \ tags, and system-managed metadata."
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          description: "Unique identifier in whole Data Ecosystem. When not provided,\
            \ Data Ecosystem will create and assign an id to the record. Must follow\
            \ the naming convention: {Data-Partition-Id}:{object-type}:{uuid}."
          example: common:work-product-component--wellLog:123456
          pattern: "^[\\w\\-\\.]+:[\\w\\-\\.]+:[\\w\\-\\.\\:\\%]+$"
        version:
          type: integer
          format: int64
          description: "Record version number, assigned by the server on each update."
          readOnly: true
        kind:
          type: string
          description: Record kind for which the schema information is applied to.
          example: common:wks:work-product-component--wellLog:1.0.0
          pattern: "^[\\w\\-\\.]+:[\\w\\-\\.]+:[\\w\\-\\.]+:[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+$"
        acl:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/Acl"
          description: Access control lists for viewers and owners.
        legal:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/Legal"
          description: Legal tags and other relevant data countries.
        data:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: true
          description: The record payload as a free-form JSON object.
          minProperties: 1
        ancestry:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/RecordAncestry"
          description: Ancestry information listing parent record IDs.
        meta:
          type: array
          description: Optional array of meta sub-objects.
          items:
            type: object
            additionalProperties: true
        tags:
          type: object
          additionalProperties:
            type: string
          description: User-defined tags as key-value pairs.
        createUser:
          type: string
          description: User who created this record.
          readOnly: true
        createTime:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: ISO 8601 timestamp of record creation.
          readOnly: true
        modifyUser:
          type: string
          description: User who last modified this record.
          readOnly: true
        modifyTime:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last modification.
          readOnly: true
      required:
      - acl
      - data
      - id
      - kind
      - legal
    RecordAncestry:
      type: object
      description: "Ancestry information for a record, listing the parent record references\
        \ from which this record was derived."
      properties:
        parents:
          type: array
          description: "List of parent records. Must follow the naming convention:\
            \ {parent-record-id}:{parent-record-version}."
          items:
            type: string
            example: opendes:osdu--wellbore:123456789:1
          uniqueItems: true
    GetCreateUpdateDatasetRegistryResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        datasetRegistries:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/Record"
    AppError:
      type: object
      description: Standard error response returned by OSDU services.
      properties:
        code:
          type: integer
          format: int32
          description: HTTP status code.
          example: 400
        reason:
          type: string
          description: Short error reason.
          example: Bad Request
        message:
          type: string
          description: Detailed error message.
          example: Invalid record format.
    GetDatasetStorageInstructionsResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        storageLocation:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: true
        providerKey:
          type: string
    GetDatasetRegistryRequest:
      type: object
      description: Dataset registry ids
      properties:
        datasetRegistryIds:
          type: array
          description: Dataset registry ids
          items:
            type: string
            example: opendes:dataset--File.Generic:8118591ee2
            minLength: 1
            pattern: "^[\\w\\-\\.]+:[\\w\\-\\.]+:[\\w\\-\\.\\:\\%]+$"
          maxItems: 20
          minItems: 1
      required:
      - datasetRegistryIds
    DatasetRetrievalProperties:
      type: object
      properties:
        datasetRegistryId:
          type: string
        retrievalProperties:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: {}
        providerKey:
          type: string
    RetrievalInstructionsResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        datasets:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/DatasetRetrievalProperties"
    ConnectedOuterService:
      type: object
      description: Name and version of an external service that this OSDU service
        connects to.
      properties:
        name:
          type: string
          description: Name of the connected external service.
          example: storage
        version:
          type: string
          description: Version of the connected external service.
          example: 2.0.0
    FeatureFlagState:
      type: object
      description: State of a feature flag for a given partition and source.
      properties:
        name:
          type: string
          description: Name of the feature flag.
          example: collaborations-api
        enabled:
          type: boolean
          description: Whether the feature flag is currently enabled.
          example: true
        partition:
          type: string
          description: Data partition this flag applies to.
          example: opendes
        source:
          type: string
          description: Source configuration that provided this flag state.
          example: runtime
    VersionInfo:
      type: object
      description: Version and build information for an OSDU service.
      properties:
        groupId:
          type: string
          description: Maven group ID of the service artifact.
          example: org.opengroup.osdu
        artifactId:
          type: string
          description: Maven artifact ID of the service.
          example: os-search
        version:
          type: string
          description: Semantic version of the deployed service.
          example: 0.27.0
        buildTime:
          type: string
          description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the build.
          example: 2021-01-26T02:24:13.843Z
        branch:
          type: string
          description: Source control branch from which the service was built.
          example: main
        commitId:
          type: string
          description: Short commit SHA of the build.
          example: "7777777"
        commitMessage:
          type: string
          description: Commit message of the build.
          example: initial commit
        connectedOuterServices:
          type: array
          description: List of external services this service depends on.
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/ConnectedOuterService"
        featureFlagStates:
          type: array
          description: "Current feature flag states for this partition, if any."
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/FeatureFlagState"

    Authorization:
      type: http
      name: Authorization
      in: header
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: Authorization
